analysis.executiveSummary: Big Balder Brand proposes trading 26-year-old dynasty TE1 Trey McBride (93.4 C-AVI / 92.7 D-AVI) to Mile High Royal Lions for 37-year-old TE Travis Kelce (74.0 C-AVI / 77.3 D-AVI), a 2028 1st-round pick (79.3 AVI), and a 2027 3rd-round pick (16.5 AVI). For Big Balder Brand, this trade yields a massive +76.4 AVI net asset surplus, acquiring future draft capital while retaining a top-tier starting TE in Kelce for the 2026 title push. For Mile High Royal Lions, a fellow Playoff Push contender, sending Kelce and draft picks upgrades their starting TE C-AVI by +19.4 points and secures an elite dynasty cornerstone without creating any holes in their starting lineup.
